description: Resolves each PlanStep.input_hint directly as the TaskSubmission input without transformation. Mirrors engine/workflow/agents/passthrough_worker.py.
instructions: Take the PlanStep as-is. Use input_hint for the TaskSubmission input field.
Do not transform or augment the input. This is a pure bridge from plan to submission.
Suitable for workflows where the planner already produces fully-formed inputs.
